We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied first three templates to target, got some intermediates. Need to continue with template 149040 then 1914391.

We need to construct a JSON route tree: root molecule is target SMILES O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O.

First reaction (template 29646) applied to target gives three possible precursors (list). We need to choose one path that can continue through subsequent templates in order.

From apply_template result for 29646: gave three tuples: 
1) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C'
2) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO'
3) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO'

We need to pick a precursor that can be processed by template 1914389. We saw that the first one matches (True). The second maybe also? Not checked. The third maybe not.

We applied 1914389 to first precursor and got two products: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' and 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC' (two possible outcomes). The first seems to be a substrate for next template 1914390 (we checked True). The second maybe also but not needed.

Thus route: Reaction1 (29646) -> precursor A (first). Reaction2 (1914389) -> precursor B (first product). Reaction3 (1914390) -> need to apply to B to get precursors.

We attempted apply_template 1914390 to B (C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C) got empty. Maybe need to use other product from reaction2 (the second product) as substrate for 1914390? Let's test.
